summary: Taget was a male Nomai who grew up on Ember Twin in the Sunless City. Once a fellow Anglerfish-game player, Taget grew taller than Laevi and could no longer fit through the Anglerfish Overlook hole. He later moved to the Statue Workshop on Giant's Deep.

location: Taget grew up in the Sunless City on Ember Twin.
Taget moved to the Statue Workshop on Giant's Deep with Lami and Laevi during Ash Twin Project construction.
lore: Taget played the Anglerfish game in the Sunless City with Lami, Laevi, Ilex, and Solanum.
Taget could no longer fit through the Anglerfish Overlook hole after growing taller than Laevi.
Taget had to seek the Stepping Stone Cave route to reach the Anglerfish fossil instead.
Taget refused Lami's plan to sneak into Phlox's memory-statue test, citing Phlox's explicit instructions.
Taget died when Ghost Matter from the Interloper killed all Nomai in the solar system.
